fullPassage: Children’s librarians frequently do not get involved in the budget process. In many smaller libraries, they are just informed of the amount they have to spend in the coming year. However, it is the responsibility of the children’s librarian to inform the administration early in the budget process of needs for the next year, including a justification of why the funds are needed. Being specific about areas of the collection which are dated and worn is more likely to bring results than a general statement that more money is needed. Put the materials budget request in writing so the director or principal has it available for budget preparation.

❌ ① (A) 수집품/자료 — (B) 수집 행위: (B)를 단순 '수집 행위'로만 보면 '모금'의 뜻을 놓쳐 틀려요.

❌ ② (A) 수집 행위 — (B) 수집품/자료: (A)·(B)가 서로 뒤바뀌어 틀려요.

✅ ③ (A) 수집품/자료 — (B) 기금 모금: (A)는 'areas of the collection'(장서의 영역=수집품/자료), (B)는 'door-to-door collection to raise funds'(기금을 모으는 모금 활동)로 정확히 구분돼요. ← 정답

❌ ④ (A) 기금 모금 — (B) 수집품/자료: (A)·(B)가 서로 뒤바뀌어 틀려요.
det.tip: collection = 수집품/장서 vs (기금) 모금 활동, 대표적인 다의어예요.

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"a reason given to explain or defend an action or decision"

det.korean: 정의 '행동이나 결정을 설명하거나 옹호하려고 대는 이유' = justification(정당화/근거).
det.analysis:
❌ ① preparation(준비): 준비를 뜻해 정의와 맞지 않아요.

✅ ② justification(근거): '행동을 설명·옹호하는 이유'라는 정의와 정확히 일치해요. ← 정답

❌ ③ administration(행정): 관리를 뜻해 정의와 달라요.

❌ ④ collection(수집): 모음을 뜻해 정의와 맞지 않아요.
det.tip: reason to explain or defend an action(행동을 설명·옹호하는 이유) → justification

questions.passage: In many smaller libraries, they are just __________ (inform) of the amount they have to spend in the coming year.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

det.korean: inform(원형) → informed. 'they are just ___'로 수동태(be+과거분사)를 만들어야 함.
det.analysis: 주어 they(사서들)는 금액을 '통보받는' 대상이에요. be동사 are 뒤에서 수동태(be+과거분사)를 만들어야 하므로 inform의 과거분사 informed를 써서 'are informed'(통보받는다)가 돼요.

questions.passage: __________ (be) specific about areas of the collection which are dated and worn is more likely to bring results than a general statement.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

det.korean: be(원형) → Being. 문장의 주어 자리에 오는 동명사(-ing)형.
det.analysis: 빈칸이 문장 맨 앞 주어 자리에 있고 뒤에 동사 is가 나와요. 동사가 주어가 되려면 동명사(-ing)가 되어야 하므로 be를 Being(~하는 것)으로 바꿔요. 'Being specific ~ is more likely to bring results'(구체적인 것이 더 결과를 가져온다)가 돼요.
det.tip: 동사가 주어 자리에 오면 동명사(-ing) → Being specific is ~

questions.passage: Children’s librarians frequently do not get involved in the budget process. In many smaller libraries, they are just informed of the amount they have to spend in the coming year. However, it is the responsibility of the children’s librarian to __________, including a justification of why the funds are needed. If the budget for the previous year was inadequate, explain why additional funds are needed. Being specific about areas of the collection which are dated and worn is more likely to bring results than a general statement that more money is needed. Put the materials budget request in writing so the director or principal has it available for budget preparation.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: inform the administration early in the budget process of needs for the next year(내년 필요를 예산 과정 초기에 행정부에 알리다) — 사서의 책임 내용.
det.analysis:
❌ ① get involved in the budget process(예산 과정에 관여하다): 사서가 종종 못 하는 일이라 '책임' 설명으로는 맞지 않아 틀려요.

❌ ② spend in the coming year(다가오는 해에 쓰다): 빈칸 자리에 맞지 않아 틀려요.

❌ ③ explain why additional funds are needed(추가 자금이 왜 필요한지 설명하다): 뒷부분의 세부 내용일 뿐 이 빈칸의 핵심 책임 표현이 아니라 틀려요.

✅ ④ inform the administration early in the budget process of needs for the next year: 원문 'it is the responsibility ~ to ___'(~하는 것이 책임이다)에 이어지는 표현이라 맞아요. ← 정답
det.tip: responsibility to inform the administration ~ of needs = 필요를 행정부에 알릴 책임

ch: get involved in the budget process
explain why additional funds are needed
inform the administration early in the budget process of needs for the next year

questions.passage: Children’s librarians frequently do not get involved in the budget process. In many smaller libraries, they are just informed of the amount they have to spend in the coming year. However, it is the responsibility of the children’s librarian to inform the administration early in the budget process of needs for the next year, including a justification of why the funds are needed. If the budget for the previous year was inadequate, explain why additional funds are needed. Being specific about areas of the collection which are dated and worn is more likely to bring results than a general statement that more money is needed. Put the materials budget request in writing so the director or principal has it __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: available for budget preparation(예산 준비에 쓸 수 있는) — 요청을 서면으로 남기는 이유.
det.analysis:
❌ ① informed of the amount they have to spend(쓸 금액을 통보받은): 빈칸 자리에 맞지 않아 틀려요.

❌ ② specific about areas of the collection(장서 영역에 대해 구체적인): 다른 문장의 내용이라 틀려요.

✅ ③ available for budget preparation(예산 준비에 쓸 수 있는): 원문 'the director ~ has it ___'(국장이 그것을 ___ 상태로 둔다)에 이어지는 표현이라 맞아요. ← 정답

❌ ④ in writing so the director or principal(국장이나 교장이 ~하도록 서면으로): 빈칸 자리에 맞지 않는 조각이라 틀려요.
det.tip: available for budget preparation = 예산 준비에 쓸 수 있는

specific about areas of the collection
in writing so the director or principal
